purpose: Bind temporal compatibility to exact shared-context evidence without inferring causation.

alignment_states.exact_context_temporally_compatible: At least one exact identifier is shared and the v7.2 pair is temporally compatible.
alignment_states.exact_context_temporally_disjoint: At least one exact identifier is shared but the v7.2 windows are disjoint beyond tolerance.
alignment_states.exact_context_time_unresolved: At least one exact identifier is shared but the time relation is unresolved.
alignment_states.temporal_only: No exact identifier is shared; temporal compatibility is the only positive alignment evidence.
alignment_states.no_alignment_evidence: No shared exact identifier and no temporal compatibility evidence.
alignment_states.source_obstruction: At least one provider-local observation is transient or unavailable.

descent.next: explicit provenance graph over exact-context and temporal evidence
